# Lambs Group

## About
Lambs Group is a family-run UK infrastructure contractor with experience built since 1988. We deliver telecoms, utilities and private works, with minor and major civils and groundworks at the heart of our capabilities. Lambs usually delivers directly: our teams work under Lambs' management, giving clients one accountable point of contact and clear oversight of safety, quality and workmanship.

Agreed slogan: Built on experience. Delivered with care.

## Sectors
- Telecoms: telecoms civils, ducting and chambers, fibre blowing and cabling, splicing and testing, FTTH/FTTP rollout, directional drilling, mole ploughing, surveys and design, cabinet installations
- Utilities: civils and infrastructure for telecoms, water, gas and electricity: ducting, jointing, mains laying, service connections, reinstatement
- Private Works (domestic): driveways and surfacing, patios and paving, bricklaying and building works, landscaping and garden improvements, fencing and drainage, groundworks and external works. Labour-only work and smaller jobs welcome. Written quotations for every project.

## Delivery support
Office and operational teams support every job: planning and scheduling, streetworks and permitting support, client and site communication, project administration, job packs and safe digging information, documentation and client systems, progress and completion records, health and safety (a dedicated Health and Safety Manager runs regular site, vehicle and equipment audits), training coordination, and plant and fleet coordination.

## Accreditations
Company accreditations: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality, certificate 200382021), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental, certificate 200392021), ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health & Safety, certificate 200402026), all certified by Citation ISO. CHAS Standard accredited (SSIP approved contractor, membership 180322). Team qualifications include NRSWA (street works), Openreach-specific training, Smart Awards (the Openreach operative accreditation card), manual handling, banksman, abrasive wheels, first aid and asbestos awareness.
